files.name: AirBattle_online.swf
files.description: Air Battle local co-op for Ruffle Together: 1-4 balloon boats in one game, each on their own keys (P1 arrows+Z+Down/X, P2 W A D+T+S/Y, P3/P4 numpad; --coop-keys air-battle), PLAYERS button on the main menu. No netcode; every player needs this exact file. 1 player is the original game. Replaces the old relay mod (ONLINE CO-OP or F9)

files.name: BadIceCream_coop.swf
files.description: Bad Ice-Cream for Ruffle Together (lockstep online co-op in the ruffle-coop build, 1.0.0 and later): the game with only the fix for levels that would not start outside the web page, and no online mod code. Both players need this exact file.

files.name: BadIceCream_online.swf
files.description: Bad Ice-Cream online co-op for Ruffle Together (lockstep co-op in the ruffle-coop build, 1.0.0 and later): the game with only the fix for levels that would not start outside the web page. The same bytes as BadIceCream_coop.swf; both players need this exact file. Replaces the old relay mod (F9 panel).

files.name: BowMan_online.swf
files.description: Bow Man for Ruffle Together: VS Human online for 2 PCs (--coop-keys bow-man; P1 W/S + Space, P2 I/K + Enter, or each player's own mouse)

files.name: ChaosFaction2_online.swf
files.description: Chaos Faction 2 for Ruffle Together: its 2-player Deathmatch on 2 PCs (--coop-keys chaos-faction-2; every player on the game's own keys: arrows, Z, X, D, Shift, T; P2 starts as Keyboard 2). One player = the original game. Everyone needs this exact file.

files.name: DadNMe_online.swf
files.description: Dad 'n Me with players 2-4 added (local co-op), played online through Ruffle Together 1.0.3.7 (--coop-keys gun-mayhem-2, --coop-players 2-4): every player on the game's own keys (arrows, A, S) on their own PC, with their own HUD and name at the top left, enemies go for the nearest player, one shared screen, a knocked-out player gets up again while anyone is standing, a friend who leaves is removed and the rest play on; friendly fire with the host's --coop-option friendlyfire=1. No netcode; every player needs this exact file. 1 player is the original game.

files.name: FireboyWatergirlForestTemple_online.swf
files.description: Fireboy & Watergirl in The Forest Temple for Ruffle Together 1.0.3.6 (--coop-keys fireboy-watergirl, 2 players): the game's own co-op, host = Fireboy, friend = Watergirl; only the ad, the online hiscore board and the sponsor links removed, no netcode. Every player needs this exact file.

files.name: gunmayhem2.swf
files.description: Gun Mayhem 2: More Mayhem, the original game (Armor Games release)

files.name: gunmayhem2_online.swf
files.description: Gun Mayhem 2 for Ruffle Together (up to 4 players online; the game's own local multiplayer, keys synced by Ruffle Together)

files.name: Intrusion_online.swf
files.description: Intrusion with local co-op for 2-4 soldiers, played online through Ruffle Together 1.0.3.8+ (every player in the room plays with the original controls: WASD, mouse aim, click or Space to shoot; shared lives, one camera, a soldier too far from the team is brought back)

files.name: Intrusion2_online.swf
files.description: Intrusion 2 with local co-op for 1-4 soldiers, played online through Ruffle Together 1.0.3.8+. The session sets the player count and every PC gets the game's own keys (WASD or arrows, Space or click fire, E action, Q/F weapon, P pause); every player aims and fires with their own mouse. No netcode; every player needs this exact file. With 1 player the co-op code is switched off.

files.name: RaftWars_online.swf
files.description: Raft Wars with 1-4 player turn co-op on the brothers' raft, online through Ruffle Together 1.0.3.6+ (--coop-keys gun-mayhem-2; every player aims with their own keys or mouse and can buy in the shop)

files.name: SmileysWar_online.swf
files.description: Smileys War for Ruffle Together (1.0.3.4 and later, --coop-keys smileys-war): 2-4 humans take the bots' places, each on their own keys and own mouse; the game with added local multiplayer, no netcode. Every player needs this exact file.

files.name: StealthAssassin_online.swf
files.description: Stealth Assassin local co-op for Ruffle Together: 1-4 assassins in one game, each on their own keys (P1 arrows+Z+X, P2 WASD+T+Y, P3/P4 numpad), PLAYERS button on the mission menu, one extra target per extra player. No netcode; every player needs this exact file. 1 player is the original game. Replaces the old relay mod (F9 panel)

files.name: stealth_hunter_2.swf
files.description: Stealth Hunter 2, the original game

files.name: stealthhunter2_online.swf
files.description: Stealth Hunter 2 with local co-op for 2-4 players, played online through Ruffle Together (--coop-keys stealth-hunter-2)

files.name: stealthhunter2_online_direct.swf
files.description: The same Ruffle Together co-op build as stealthhunter2_online.swf (no sponsor preloader)

files.name: TerritoryWar_online.swf
files.description: Territory War for Ruffle Together: red against blue on 2-4 PCs, each player plays only their own turns, rotated or by stick (--coop-option turns=stick; --coop-keys territory-war, Ruffle Together 1.0.3.7+)

files.name: UltimateAssassin1_online.swf
files.description: Ultimate Assassin with the Multiplayer Everything online co-op mod, up to 4 players, one extra target per extra player, room codes or Direct IP (Ruffle; ONLINE CO-OP on the menu or F9)

files.name: UltimateAssassin2_online.swf
files.description: Ultimate Assassin 2 with the Multiplayer Everything online co-op mod, up to 4 players, one extra target per extra player, room codes or Direct IP (Ruffle; ONLINE CO-OP on the menu or F9)

files.name: UltimateAssassin3_online.swf
files.description: Ultimate Assassin 3 with the Multiplayer Everything online co-op mod, up to 4 players, one extra target per extra player, room codes or Direct IP (Ruffle; ONLINE CO-OP on the menu or F9)

files.name: UltimateCrabBattle_online.swf
files.description: Ultimate Crab Battle for Ruffle Together (1.0.3.8+): every player in the session gets a ship (2-4) and plays with the game's own keys: arrows, A to fire, Ctrl, 1-3, Y/N. One player outside a session = the original game. Everyone needs this exact file.

files.name: Zombotron_online.swf
files.description: Zombotron with players 2-4 added, online through Ruffle Together 1.0.3.8 (--coop-keys gun-mayhem-2; the game then sets its own keys): each player on their own keys and own mouse, a camera per player, a panel and name per player. No netcode; every player needs this exact file. 1 player is the original game.
